_note: Hex events. Gains and costs of food/wood/stone/gold use the Champion's CARGO, delivered when you get home. terrain: which terrains can roll it. band: minimum danger band (0 safe, 1 uncertain, 2 wild). weight: relative odds. Effects: food/wood/stone/gold go to the kingdom; hp/xp/moves to the Champion; end_day stops the day.

trail.title: An old logging trail
trail.text: Half-hidden under ferns, a cart track runs the way you are going.

options.label: Follow it
options.text: The going is easy. +2 moves.

lost.title: The path forks, then forks again
lost.text: Mist sits in the hollows. Every tree looks like the last one.

success.text: Moss on the north side, water downhill. You keep your bearings.

fail.text: You walk in a wide circle until dusk. The day is spent.

options.label: Make camp and wait it out
options.text: You rest. The mist lifts by morning.

boars.title: Wild hogs!
boars.text: Two wild hogs and their bristling king burst out of the gorse. They do not want to share the path.

success.text: You scramble up the scree. Safe, but the day is spent.

fail.text: A tusk catches your leg. -3 HP, and they still block the path.

options.label: Throw them food
options.text: The hogs forget you exist. The path is clear.

wolves.title: Eyes in the dark
wolves.text: A wolf pack has been pacing you for an hour. Now they close in.

success.text: They think better of it and melt into the trees.

fail.text: They are not impressed.

bandits.title: A toll nobody voted for
bandits.text: Three people with cudgels and a rope across the road. 'Fifteen gold, friend.'

options.label: Pay them
options.text: They wave you through, almost politely.

success.text: By the end they are asking you for work. You promise to remember them.

fail.text: 'Nice speech.' They raise the cudgels.

berries.title: A slope heavy with berries
berries.text: Someone should pick these before the birds do.

options.label: Fill your pack
options.text: +12 Food into your cargo. Now get it home.

cache.title: A cairn that isn't a cairn
cache.text: The stones are stacked too neatly. Something is underneath.

options.label: Dig
options.text: An old smuggler's purse. +25 Gold into your cargo.

options.label: Leave the dead their money
options.text: You walk on. It feels right, somehow.

traveler.title: A traveler going the other way
traveler.text: A tired woman with a mule. She looks like she has seen the road ahead.

success.text: She describes the land ahead in detail. The map fills in around you.

fail.text: She talks mostly about her mule.

spring.title: A warm spring
spring.text: Steam rises off a pool between the rocks. It smells of iron.

options.label: Soak your wounds
options.text: +6 HP. You feel almost new.

rain.title: The sky opens
rain.text: Cold, sideways rain. The ground turns to soup.

success.text: Wet, but unbothered.

fail.text: Every step is a fight. -2 moves.

options.label: Shelter under a ledge
options.text: You wait it out. No more walking today, but you stay dry.

rockslide.title: Loose scree
rockslide.text: The slope shifts under your boots.

success.text: You land badly, but you land.

fail.text: A rock catches your shoulder. -3 HP.

success.text: Bruised, standing.

fail.text: -4 HP.

woodpile.title: Abandoned woodcutters' camp
woodpile.text: Neat stacks of seasoned logs, and nobody around to claim them.

options.label: Load what you can carry
options.text: +12 Wood into your cargo.

pilgrim.title: A pilgrim with nowhere to go
pilgrim.text: His village burned last winter. He asks where a man can start again.

success.text: He walks toward your banners with his family. +1 person.

fail.text: He thanks you and keeps walking.

options.label: Give him bread
options.text: He blesses your name. It costs you nothing you will miss.

peddler.title: A peddler's cart
peddler.text: Pots, ribbon, and a jar of something green. 'Good for cuts, very good.'

options.label: Buy the salve (10 gold)
options.text: One healing salve, slightly sticky.

success.text: He gives it to you for a story. One healing salve.

fail.text: He laughs and closes the jar.

supplies.title: Abandoned supplies
supplies.text: A broken cart, a dead mule, and crates nobody came back for.

options.label: Take what's useful
options.text: +6 Wood, +6 Stone into your cargo.

success.text: A false bottom. +18 Gold and some timber.

fail.text: Hours of prying boards. +4 Wood, and the day is gone.

shrine.title: A shrine to a forgotten saint
shrine.text: Carvings, half worn away. Fresh flowers at the base.

success.text: A saint of roads and travelers. You feel lighter. +15 XP.

fail.text: Pretty, whatever it means.

options.label: Leave an offering
options.text: +4 HP. Maybe it's the quiet.

smith.title: A wandering smith
smith.text: An anvil on a handcart and arms like tree roots. 'Something sharp? Something sturdy?'

options.label: Buy a padded vest (15 gold)
options.text: It smells of sheep, but it'll turn a blade.

success.text: You work till dusk. He pays you, and calls you a natural.

fail.text: A spark finds your sleeve. He laughs, not unkindly.

wounded_soldier.title: A soldier by the road
wounded_soldier.text: No banner, a bad leg, and nothing to eat for two days.

options.label: Share your bread
options.text: He eats like a wolf and promises to remember your face.

options.label: Carry him to the next village

success.text: Heavy going. He doesn't stop thanking you.

fail.text: You make it halfway before your back gives out. Others take him from there.

options.label: Leave him
options.text: You don't look back. It takes effort.

soldier_returns.title: A familiar limp
soldier_returns.text: The soldier you helped, walking straight now, with a sack over his shoulder.

options.label: 'You remembered.'
options.text: 'Couldn't forget.' Supplies, and a trick he learned in the war.

options.label: Ask him to settle in your capital
options.text: He'll go. One more pair of hands at home.

smuggler.title: A man with too many pockets
smuggler.text: He stands where the trees are thickest and smiles too quickly.

options.label: Buy a smoke bomb (12 gold)
options.text: 'For leaving parties early.'

success.text: He pays for your silence and the merchants hear of your honesty anyway.

fail.text: He whistles. Friends step out of the trees.

options.label: Look away
options.text: He presses a coin into your hand. You feel a little smaller.

pilgrims.title: Pilgrims at the well
pilgrims.text: Grey robes, bare feet, and a very old song.

options.label: Offer them wine
options.text: The eldest ties a charm of bark and string around your wrist.

options.label: Walk a stretch with them
options.text: Slow going, but your feet and heart feel lighter.

toll_bridge.title: A toll on the old bridge
toll_bridge.text: Three men and a rope across the bridge. 'Five gold to cross, friend.'

options.label: Pay (5 gold)
options.text: They lift the rope with a bow.

success.text: By the end they're paying YOU a toll. Well, nearly.

fail.text: They don't budge. You go the long way round.

beehive.title: A humming oak
beehive.text: The whole tree buzzes. There's honey in there, a lot of it.

options.label: Smoke them out with a torch
options.text: The bees grumble off. Two good combs.

success.text: Quick hands! One comb, no stings.

fail.text: Stung, stung and stung again.

lost_sheep.title: A sheep with no shepherd
lost_sheep.text: It bleats at you as if this were your fault.

options.label: Take it home
options.text: It complains the whole way. +6 food in the cargo.

success.text: A grateful farmer pays you in coins and gossip.

fail.text: Nobody claims it. You let it graze.

success.text: An old kill, long abandoned. You take a tooth for luck.

fail.text: The tracks double back. So do the wolves.

options.label: Go around
options.text: Safer, slower.

meteor.title: A smoking crater
meteor.text: Last night's falling star landed here. The ground is still warm.

success.text: A shard of black metal, heavy as sin. A smith would weep.

fail.text: It burns your hands, but you get it out.

options.label: Leave it to the sky
options.text: Some things aren't meant for pockets.

old_trap.title: A fox in a snare
old_trap.text: An old hunter's trap, and a fox that is very tired of it.

success.text: It bolts — and leaves behind a coin it was lying on. Lucky.

fail.text: It bites you on the way out. Ungrateful.

options.label: Take the trap for the iron
options.text: Mostly wood, really. +3 wood.

whispering_stone.title: The whispering stone
whispering_stone.text: A standing stone. When the wind moves, it almost says your name.

success.text: It tells you where the hermit buried his spare charm. Of course it does.

fail.text: Just wind. And a headache.

night_lights.title: Lights between the trees
night_lights.text: Small and blue, moving like they're looking for something.

options.label: Follow them with a torch
options.text: They lead you to a mossy altar. Something old was left on it.

success.text: Your eyes adjust. The altar, the relic, the silence.

fail.text: You wake at dawn in a ditch with no idea how.

abandoned_camp.title: A cold camp
abandoned_camp.text: Bedrolls, a pot, ashes. Whoever was here left in a hurry.

options.label: Take what's useful
options.text: Trail rations and a torch.

success.text: Under a stone: a scrap of map, carefully hidden.

fail.text: Nothing but crumbs. Something has eaten the rations.

grave_robbers.title: Shovels at the barrow
grave_robbers.text: Two men, a hole, and something wrapped in cloth.

options.label: Buy what they found (25 gold)
options.text: They're happy to be rid of it. That's never a good sign.

success.text: They drop it and run. You'll return it to a shrine — or not.

fail.text: They laugh and keep digging.

petition.title: A farmer's petition
petition.text: 'My lord, the frost took the seed. Spare a sack, and I'll farm for your town.'

options.label: Give 10 food
options.text: One more family settles near your walls.

options.label: Not this year
options.text: He nods. He's heard it before.

foreign_scouts.title: Scouts in {rival} colours
foreign_scouts.text: They're mapping the road. They weren't expecting you.

options.label: Share wine by the fire
options.text: By the second cup they're telling you about their captain.

success.text: They go. They'll remember your face.

fail.text: They don't scare easily.

starving_village.title: A hungry village
starving_village.text: Thin children, empty granary. The headman doesn't ask, he just looks.

options.label: Give 20 food
options.text: They will remember this for a generation.

options.label: You can't spare it
options.text: You ride on. The silence follows you.

village_thanks.title: A gift from the village
village_thanks.text: A cart arrives with the village you fed — and their thanks.

options.label: Accept it
options.text: Coins, a lucky charm, and a song they made about you.

herbalist_hut.title: A hut full of drying herbs
herbalist_hut.text: An old woman with green fingers squints at you.

options.label: Buy tea (5 gold)
options.text: Two pouches. 'For the bleeding kind of days.'

success.text: You leave with two salves you made yourself.

fail.text: She sighs and sends you off with a list of words you didn't catch.

fisher.title: A fisher mending nets
fisher.text: A good catch drying on the rocks.

options.label: Buy fish (3 gold)
options.text: +8 food in the cargo.

success.text: A heavy haul. Half of it is yours.

fail.text: You fall in. Everyone enjoys that except you.

courier.title: A courier, searching
courier.text: 'A sealed letter — lost on this road. Have you seen it?'

options.label: Hand it over
options.text: He pays you twice over and swears you to secrecy.

options.label: Say nothing
options.text: He walks on, worried.

buried_chest.title: X marks the spot
buried_chest.text: The map scrap matches this hillside exactly.

options.label: Dig where the map says
options.text: A rotted chest: coins and an uncut stone.

bard.title: A travelling bard
bard.text: She tunes a lute and asks what your story is.

options.label: Pay for a song (5 gold)
options.text: A marching song. Your feet want to keep going.

success.text: Passers-by throw coins. She splits them with you.

fail.text: She politely suggests you don't.

goblin_ambush.title: Goblins in the ditch
goblin_ambush.text: Three goblins pop out of a ditch, giggling, waving rusty knives. 'Toll! Toll!'

options.label: Pay the 'toll'
options.text: They count the coins three times and wave you through.

success.text: You roar. They scatter into the bushes, still giggling.

fail.text: They are not impressed.

cave_mouth.title: A cold draught
cave_mouth.text: Air pours out of a crack in the hillside. Deep inside something glitters — and something squeaks.

success.text: A seam of fool's gold and a forgotten purse. +15 gold.

fail.text: Bats! You back out, scratched.

options.label: Mark it on the map and go
options.text: Somebody else's adventure.

slime_puddle.title: The puddle moved
slime_puddle.text: The puddle on the path wobbles. Then it blinks.

success.text: It gurgles sadly as you pass.

fail.text: It grabs your boot. You spend the afternoon getting it back.

shipwreck.title: Wreck on the shore
shipwreck.text: A broken hull on the rocks. Crabs the size of shields guard it jealously.

success.text: A sea chest: gold and a pearl.

fail.text: A claw closes on your ankle. You limp away empty-handed.

pirate_camp.title: Smoke on the beach
pirate_camp.text: Pirates around a fire, arguing over a map. One of them spots you.

success.text: They hand you the map to 'take to the captain'.

fail.text: 'We ARE the captain.'

options.label: Back away slowly
options.text: You take the long way round.

restless_grave.title: Fresh earth at midnight
restless_grave.text: A grave on the roadside. The earth is moving — from the inside.

success.text: The earth goes still. Whoever it was rests again.

fail.text: The prayer is wrong. Bony fingers grab at you.

kobold_traders.title: Kobold traders
kobold_traders.text: Two kobolds with a sack of shiny rocks. They want to trade. They really want your buttons.

options.label: Trade food for rocks
options.text: The 'shiny rocks' are iron ore. +6 iron.

success.text: They draw you a map of the tunnels in the dirt.

fail.text: Lots of squeaking. You understand none of it.

sheep_herder.title: Too many sheep
sheep_herder.text: A shepherd boy with far too many sheep for one boy. 'Will you buy one? Please?'

options.label: Buy a few (10 gold)
options.text: Mutton for the capital. +20 food.

options.label: Help him herd them home
options.text: His family settles in your capital. +1 person.

knight_errant.title: A knight errant
knight_errant.text: A knight in dented armour blocks the bridge. 'None shall pass without a friendly bout!'

success.text: You knock him on his backside. He gives you his spare vest, laughing.

fail.text: He wins, then helps you up.

options.label: Flatter him into letting you pass

success.text: He blushes and steps aside.

fail.text: He insists on telling you his life story.

rival_archers.title: Archers on the ridge
rival_archers.text: Foreign archers drill on a ridge — inside what you thought was nobody's land.

options.label: Demand they leave
options.text: They leave, glaring. Word will travel.

options.label: Ask to watch and learn
options.text: They show you a trick with the wind.

monk_blessing.title: A wandering monk
monk_blessing.text: A monk sits under a tree, perfectly still. He opens one eye. 'You are tired.'

options.label: Sit with him a while
options.text: You wake at dusk, rested. The monk is gone.

options.label: Give him bread
options.text: He gives you a pouch of tea in return.

merchant_caravan.title: A caravan in trouble
merchant_caravan.text: A merchant caravan with a broken axle. The drivers look nervously at the treeline.

options.label: Help fix the axle
options.text: They pay you well and promise to tell their guild.

options.label: Guard them until dark
options.text: Nothing comes. They pay anyway.

bat_swarm.title: The sky goes dark
bat_swarm.text: Bats pour out of a hillside — hundreds of them, then a few very big ones.

success.text: They pass over you like a black wind.

fail.text: Tiny teeth, many of them.

fallen_scout.title: A fallen scout
fallen_scout.text: A scout from a neighbouring kingdom lies in the grass. Long dead. His satchel is still sealed.

options.label: Return the satchel to his kingdom
options.text: They will remember this.

options.label: Read his letters
options.text: His notes mark the land ahead.

gold_vein.title: A glint in the stream
gold_vein.text: Something yellow glints in the streambed.

success.text: Real gold dust. +25 gold.

fail.text: Pyrite. A whole afternoon of pyrite.
